policy: Public conclusions only. Never expose acquisition method, watchlists, issue or PR identifiers, source URLs, query strategy, private evidence graph or operational provenance.

headline.en: The harness is becoming the product.
headline.deck_en: The important competition is moving beyond model quality. Hooks, skills, delegation, recovery, permissions and runtime state are becoming the control plane that decides whether agents are dependable.
headline.deck_fr: La compétition importante dépasse la qualité du modèle. Hooks, skills, délégation, reprise, permissions et état runtime deviennent le plan de contrôle qui décide si les agents sont fiables.

second_fixes.title_en: The first logging fix attacked the symptom. The second fix moved the control to the real sink.
second_fixes.title_fr: Le premier correctif de logging attaquait le symptôme. Le second a déplacé le contrôle vers le vrai sink.
sequence_en: High-volume persistent logging creates extreme local write churn
A transformed-event path still escapes the filter
The control is moved closer to the final SQLite write boundary
sequence_fr: Une journalisation persistante à fort volume provoque une forte amplification des écritures locales
Un chemin d’événements transformés contourne encore le filtre
Le contrôle est déplacé au plus près de l’écriture SQLite finale
second_fixes.lesson_en: The second fix revealed that the original abstraction boundary was wrong. Controls belong where the side effect is committed, not merely where input first appears.
second_fixes.lesson_fr: Le second correctif a révélé que la frontière d’abstraction initiale était mauvaise. Le contrôle doit vivre là où l’effet est réellement commis, pas seulement là où l’entrée apparaît.

second_fixes.title_en: A permission fix can still leave the same failure family alive.
second_fixes.title_fr: Un correctif de permissions peut laisser vivre la même famille de panne.
sequence_en: A later regression appears on the same permission surface
The real problem becomes enforcement consistency rather than parsing alone
sequence_fr: Le parsing des commandes composées est renforcé
Le changement est considéré comme terminé
Une régression ultérieure apparaît sur la même surface de permissions
Le vrai problème devient la cohérence de l’enforcement plutôt que le seul parsing
second_fixes.lesson_en: A closed fix is weak evidence. Recurrence on the same control surface is stronger evidence about the architecture.
second_fixes.lesson_fr: Un correctif fermé est une preuve faible. Une récidive sur la même surface de contrôle est une preuve plus forte sur l’architecture.

second_fixes.title_en: Automation can fail in several different ways and still report success.
second_fixes.title_fr: L’automatisation peut échouer de plusieurs façons tout en annonçant un succès.
sequence_en: A rate limit prevents the requested change
A fatal API path still exits successfully
A command-handling path can swallow the intended operation
Community fixes exist but maintenance absorption weakens
sequence_fr: Une limitation de débit empêche la modification demandée
Un chemin d’erreur API fatale sort pourtant en succès
Un chemin de traitement de commande peut avaler l’opération attendue
Des correctifs communautaires existent mais l’absorption de maintenance faiblit
second_fixes.lesson_en: False success is not one bug. It is a contract failure between the harness and automation around it.
second_fixes.lesson_fr: Le faux succès n’est pas un seul bug. C’est une rupture de contrat entre le harnais et l’automatisation qui l’entoure.

atlas.why_en: This is becoming the main enforcement boundary: before tools run, after tools run, at stop, at session start and around external integrations.
atlas.why_fr: Cela devient la principale frontière d’enforcement : avant les outils, après les outils, à l’arrêt, au démarrage de session et autour des intégrations externes.

projects.Claude Code: Broad event model; plugin hooks; organizational controls can restrict project/user hooks.
projects.Codex: Dedicated hook runtime; trust/review surfaces; MCP and subagent context; managed hook requirements.
projects.Gemini CLI: Planner + registry + aggregator; project hooks are disabled in untrusted folders; migration from Claude hooks.
projects.Goose: Hooks evolved from observation to blocking policy; failure policy can explicitly allow or block.
projects.Cline: Dedicated hook layer around execution/connectors with explicit execution timeout behavior.
projects.OpenHands: Hook execution is visible as runtime events with blocked/success states.

atlas.why_en: Skills are no longer just prompt files. Discovery, precedence, enablement, invocation policy, distribution and the model-visible installed copy now matter.
atlas.why_fr: Les skills ne sont plus de simples fichiers de prompt. Discovery, precedence, activation, politique d’invocation, distribution et copie réellement visible par le modèle comptent désormais.

projects.Claude Code: Plugin skills coexist with agents, hooks and MCP; skills load by contextual match.
projects.Codex: Explicit discovery order, enable/disable state, watcher, trust surfaces and context-budget handling.
projects.Gemini CLI: Bundled/user/project discovery layers; extension precedence; install/link/enable/disable lifecycle.
projects.Goose: Developing reusable capability model alongside protocolized agents.
projects.Cline: Reusable control/configuration surfaces are developing around its execution harness.
projects.OpenHands: Capabilities increasingly sit inside a broader runtime and agent-control architecture.

atlas.why_en: Once a hook becomes a guardrail, failure of the guardrail itself must have a defined outcome.
atlas.why_fr: Quand un hook devient un garde-fou, la panne du garde-fou lui-même doit avoir une issue définie.

projects.Claude Code: Behavior depends on hook type and control layer; organizational policy can restrict local controls.
projects.Codex: Trust and managed-hook surfaces make control availability explicit, but semantics remain context-dependent.
projects.Gemini CLI: Trust state can disable project hooks and MCP-related surfaces before execution.
projects.Goose: Most explicit evolution: policy denial separated from hook failure; on-failure behavior can be configured.
projects.Cline: Execution timeout creates a distinct failure state that the surrounding workflow must interpret.
projects.OpenHands: Blocked versus successful hook execution is represented in runtime state.

atlas.why_en: Delegation creates a second control plane: who receives work, what context crosses the boundary, how the result returns and how failures recover.
atlas.why_fr: La délégation crée un second plan de contrôle : qui reçoit le travail, quel contexte traverse la frontière, comment le résultat revient et comment les échecs sont repris.

projects.Claude Code: Specialized agents are selected by capability and can coexist inside plugins with skills/hooks.
projects.Codex: Subagent hook context and orchestrator/executor skill separation make delegation an explicit subsystem.
projects.Gemini CLI: Developing agent execution and scheduler surfaces with hook-mediated stopping behavior.
projects.Goose: Protocolized agent direction increasingly makes handoff/interoperability a first-class concern.
projects.Cline: Delegation remains less central than its tool-execution control plane.
projects.OpenHands: Multi-agent/runtime architecture makes task handoff and execution state central.

atlas.why_en: Recovering the transcript is insufficient when workspace, provider, model, permissions or execution identity have changed.
atlas.why_fr: Récupérer le transcript ne suffit pas si workspace, provider, modèle, permissions ou identité d’exécution ont changé.

projects.Claude Code: Session lifecycle controls are growing, but recovery guarantees vary by execution path.
projects.Codex: Worktrees, thread/session state and checkpoint-like surfaces are becoming more explicit.
projects.Gemini CLI: Memory and trust state are distinct from tool/session execution state.
projects.Goose: Active architectural evolution around protocolized sessions and agent state.
projects.Cline: Strong workspace/checkpoint orientation relative to many peers.
projects.OpenHands: Runtime/workspace state is fundamental to recovery rather than an incidental attachment.

atlas.why_en: Shared protocols reduce bespoke integration, but they do not standardize permissions, trust, failure policy or runtime ownership.
atlas.why_fr: Les protocoles communs réduisent les intégrations spécifiques, mais ne standardisent pas permissions, confiance, politique d’échec ou ownership runtime.

projects.Claude Code: MCP is integrated as a plugin component alongside agents, hooks and skills.
projects.Codex: MCP integrates into hooks and tool runtime with explicit trust surfaces.
projects.Gemini CLI: MCP management is coupled to trust boundaries and hook execution.
projects.Goose: Protocol-first direction is becoming a major architectural axis.
projects.Cline: MCP/tool connectivity is part of the practical execution surface.
projects.OpenHands: External tool/runtime integration is part of a broader agent execution architecture.

timeline_en: Forked out of the Cline lineage
Expanded into its own product/cloud direction
Product surfaces were deliberately dismantled
A final release was cut
Repository was archived while continuity moved to community alternatives
timeline_fr: Issu d’un fork de la lignée Cline
Extension vers sa propre direction produit/cloud
Les surfaces produit ont été volontairement démontées
Une version finale a été publiée
Le repository a été archivé tandis que la continuité se déplaçait vers des alternatives communautaires
trajectories.meaning_en: A large open backlog was not evidence of a future roadmap. It became a fossil of unfinished intent.
trajectories.meaning_fr: Un grand backlog ouvert n’était pas la preuve d’une roadmap future. Il est devenu le fossile d’intentions inachevées.

timeline_en: Hooks begin as non-blocking extension points
Pre-tool hooks gain blocking power
Failure of the policy hook itself becomes a design problem
Failure semantics become configurable
Protocolized agents and interoperability become a larger architectural axis
timeline_fr: Les hooks commencent comme points d’extension non bloquants
Les hooks pré-outil acquièrent un pouvoir de blocage
La panne du hook de politique devient elle-même un problème de conception
La sémantique d’échec devient configurable
Les agents protocolisés et l’interopérabilité prennent une place architecturale croissante
trajectories.meaning_en: The project is moving from extensibility toward explicit enforcement and protocol boundaries.
trajectories.meaning_fr: Le projet passe de l’extensibilité vers un enforcement explicite et des frontières de protocole.

timeline_en: Mature coding-agent product with long release history
False-success automation problems recur across different mechanisms
Release cadence weakens materially
Community fixes continue to appear
Maintenance absorption becomes visibly slower
timeline_fr: Agent de code mature avec un long historique de releases
Les faux succès d’automatisation récidivent via plusieurs mécanismes
La cadence de releases faiblit nettement
Des correctifs communautaires continuent d’apparaître
L’absorption de maintenance devient visiblement plus lente
trajectories.meaning_en: Not dead and not officially abandoned, but the maintenance system is no longer absorbing change at its earlier pace.
trajectories.meaning_fr: Ni mort ni officiellement abandonné, mais le système de maintenance n’absorbe plus le changement au rythme précédent.

timeline_en: Major multi-agent framework
Moves into maintenance rather than new-feature growth
Strategic direction shifts toward a successor framework
Migration becomes the future path while legacy maintenance remains
timeline_fr: Framework multi-agent majeur
Passe en maintenance plutôt qu’en croissance fonctionnelle
La direction stratégique se déplace vers un framework successeur
La migration devient le chemin futur tandis que la maintenance legacy continue
trajectories.meaning_en: Supersession is not the same as death: the old system can remain maintained while the architectural future moves elsewhere.
trajectories.meaning_fr: Le remplacement n’est pas la mort : l’ancien système peut rester maintenu tandis que l’avenir architectural se déplace ailleurs.

timeline_en: Distinctive skill/workflow methodology emerges
Patterns spread across multiple coding-agent environments
Sustained activity turns the project from curiosity into a meaningful architectural signal
timeline_fr: Une méthodologie distinctive de skills/workflows émerge
Les patterns se diffusent dans plusieurs environnements d’agents de code
Une activité soutenue transforme le projet de curiosité en signal architectural significatif
trajectories.meaning_en: Influence can matter before market share. Repeated cross-harness adoption is the stronger signal.
trajectories.meaning_fr: L’influence peut compter avant la part de marché. L’adoption répétée entre harnais est le signal le plus fort.

timeline_en: Canonical repository identity changes organization
Old path redirects
Active development continues under the new identity
Hook architecture remains substantial across agent, environment and run layers
timeline_fr: L’identité canonique du repository change d’organisation
L’ancien chemin redirige
Le développement actif continue sous la nouvelle identité
L’architecture de hooks reste substantielle aux niveaux agent, environnement et run
trajectories.meaning_en: Repository silence or redirect must be resolved before calling a project abandoned.
trajectories.meaning_fr: Un silence ou une redirection de repository doit être résolu avant de déclarer un projet abandonné.
